problem_statement: Shopify store owners doing $20k+/mo manually check competitor stores for price changes and miss undercuts that cost them sales; there is no cheap automated weekly competitor price-monitoring report tailored to their SKUs.
target_segment: Shopify store owners with >$20k/mo revenue in competitive niches
notes: Strong buyer with budget: these owners already pay $20-100/mo for Shopify apps (Prisync, Price2Spy exist at $50-200/mo). Fully automatable: scrape public competitor product pages + Claude writes a weekly diff report emailed automatically. No per-customer human work once set up. Recurring monthly value.
